subject: Phased net-term harmonization & onboarding checklist for FastTrack
messages:
From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: FastTrack AP <ap@fasttrackinc.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding + payment terms question

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to start the vendor onboarding for FastTrack; procurement asked for the vendor packet and the PO routing details so we can get our first invoice in the queue. A couple of things up front:

- What is Redwood's default payment term for new suppliers (Net30/45/60)?
- Do you offer early-pay options / discounts if we elect faster payment?
- Is there a preferred invoice format and where should we send invoices/remittance?

I've attached our completed vendor onboarding sheet and a copy of our W-9. Let me know if you need anything else from legal or tax.

Attachments: FastTrack_vendor_onboarding.xlsx (XLSX), FastTrack_W-9.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Elena Russo
Head of Strategic Sourcing
FastTrack Inc.
elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + payment terms question

Elena —

Welcome — great to see the packet. Quick answers up front: our standard for new vendors is Net45; we route POs via procurement and invoices to AP (ap@redwood.com). We do offer an early-pay program: for Net30 effective payment you can opt into a 1.5% early-pay discount if FastTrack wants to accelerate by 15 days. We also evaluate bespoke terms for some enterprise partners on a case-by-case basis.

To keep things moving, I'll attach our PO template and a short checklist for invoice metadata we need: PO number, invoice number, remit-to details, and the billing contact email. Can you confirm the bank/ACH information you plan to share (we'll only pass to Finance) and whether FastTrack prefers invoice batching or immediate submission per milestone?

Attachment: redwood_po_template.pdf

Can loop in Naomi from Finance for any exceptions. Marissa from Accounts will coordinate the onboarding timeline. Proposed next steps:
- FastTrack returns signed onboarding form + bank details
- Redwood issues PO (we'll use a provisional PO number for the first 30 days if needed)
- First invoice processed under Net45; if you sign up for early-pay we'll apply the discount in the payment run

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0133

From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: FastTrack AP <ap@fasttrackinc.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + payment terms question

Michael —

Thanks for the clarity. A couple follow-ups from our side:

- Procurement prefers Net60 for suppliers of our size to match our cashflow; is Redwood willing to consider Net60 for the first 90 days (pilot) with milestone invoicing?
- If we request an accelerated-pay option (Net15) for certain invoice lines, would Redwood be open to 2% discount?

If Net45 is non-negotiable, we may sign that but want to flag the request in case we can arrange a short-term Net60 for the initial 90-day onboarding window. We'll return the signed forms today and include bank details.

Elena

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + payment terms question

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the packet and the follow-up. From Finance's perspective:

- Standard onboarding term: Net45 for new vendors to allow one close cycle.
- We can pilot Net60 for the first 90 days if invoices are tied to clear milestones and you accept a provisional PO number until the vendor is fully activated. That reduces downstream reconciliation work.
- Early-pay: we can offer a 1.5% discount for payment within 15 days on a program basis; a 2% discount for Net15 would be evaluated but is uncommon for new suppliers because it materially affects our working capital model.

Invoice metadata requirements (please include on every submission):
- Redwood PO: must be on the invoice header
- FastTrack invoice number and date
- Line-level description and quantity (if applicable)
- Remit-to: FastTrack bank/ACH details or remit instructions
- Billing contact email for any exceptions (ap@fasttrackinc.com is fine)

Attachment: invoice_spec_sample.pdf

If you're open to the pilot, we'll mark the PO with a "NET60-PILOT" flag and schedule a 30-day reconciliation to confirm workflow. For immediate activation under Net45, we'll issue the formal PO within two business days after we receive the signed onboarding packet and bank details.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 09:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + payment terms question

Elena —

Happy to own the onboarding timeline. Quick checklist and asks from Redwood CS/ops:

1) Signed onboarding form (we received the spreadsheet but need a signed DocuSign). Link: https://docusign.com/signer/ABCDE-12345
2) Bank/ACH remit-to details (will be stored in our finance portal)
3) Tax forms (W-9 received)
4) Point of contact for PO approvals and any invoicing exceptions

If you agree to Net45 for activation we can issue a PO today and include an optional early-pay enrollment box for the 1.5%/15-day program. If you prefer to pilot Net60, please confirm milestone definitions so we can flag the PO accordingly.

I'll set up a 30-minute onboarding call for Thursday to walk through PO flow and invoicing. Proposed attendees: Michael (partnerships), Naomi (finance), Logan (engineering ops), and your AP lead.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@fasttrackinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, FastTrack AP <ap@fasttrackinc.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + payment terms question

Marissa / team —

Thanks, all. FastTrack will sign the DocuSign today and return bank details. We are happy to accept Net45 for initial activation and will opt into the 1.5% early-pay program for the first two invoices to speed cashflow while we get aligned. We'll also propose milestone definitions for a Net60 pilot if we decide to pursue that after the initial 60 days.

Action items confirmed:
- FastTrack: sign DocuSign + send ACH details (Elena / AP)
- Redwood: issue PO once onboarding packet and bank info received (Michael / Marissa / Naomi)
- Schedule onboarding call (Marissa to propose times)

Elena Russo
Head of Strategic Sourcing
FastTrack Inc.
